title: Norainu to Tenshi-chan Manga Goes on Hiatus, Moves to Yanmaga Web
content: The June issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Young Magazine revealed on Wednesday that Naru Narumi 's Norainu to Tenshi-chan (Stray Dog and Angel) manga will go on hiatus, and will move to Kodansha 's YanMaga Web service beginning with its 10th chapter. The ninth chapter in the current issue is the final one in the magazine.
